▼Glossary column definitions
Term Formula Meaning
Net Exposureworst-case loss after offsetsAccounts for offsetting positions (e.g., Over/Under can't both hit)
Weighted RiskΣ payout × P(other legs hit)Expected payout if this selection hits, weighted by the probability each parlay's other legs also hit. Smaller than Max Payout.
Max PayoutΣ full payoutWorst-case maximum liability if every parlay hits in full. Equals the sum of My Risk values in the detail drop-down.
Remainingmax_per_team − net exposureCapacity before risk gate blocks new quotes
Stakes Heldsum of bettor stakes on a gameMoney in pocket; kept if parlays lose
Net Exposure ★max over sides of (payouts owed − opposite stakes)True worst-case loss after offsets. The one to watch.
% of Limitnet / (bankroll × max_per_game_pct)Game’s share of the per-game cap
Team Exposure is gross (no netting). Game Exposure is net (post-offset). Same team can look big in Team but tiny in Game if the opposite side offsets it.

Per-Day Breakdown
Network demand = RFQs PX broadcast to us (quoted + declined). Network matched = parlays any SP filled (deduped). Network we bid on = matched parlays where we submitted an offer. Share of matched = my fills / network matched (our slice of total demand satisfied). Bid win rate = my fills / network we bid on (how often we win the auctions we enter).
The volume charts use two Y-axes per chart: left (network-scale) and right (our-scale). Bars are auto-sized against their own axis so the trends in each series stay readable despite the ~10× magnitude gap.
Bid-win-rate before ~2026-05-12 is omitted — matched_parlays.we_quoted wasn't reliably persisted for lost auctions before then, so older numbers would be artificially near 100%. The trend chart's vertical divider marks where honest data starts. Share-of-matched is reliable across the full window. Cached 60s server-side; days bucketed in US Eastern.
▼Counterparty Performance
Window: Min fills:
-
Expand to load counterparty data
creator_id is the only counterparty identifier PX exposes (per Alec). Forward-captured on every RFQ since 2026-05-19 (live deploy); backfilled for ~30-45 days of historical rows from PX REST. Older parlay_orders predate PX's retention window and can't be tagged retroactively — they appear as "untagged" in the summary.
SP P&L = our profit (positive) or loss (negative). Bettor ROI = -P&L / stake from the bettor's perspective; positive means this counterparty is beating us. Bettor hit rate = fraction of their settled parlays the bettor won. Rows sorted by bettor ROI descending — sharps at the top. Cached 60s server-side.

▼Definitions
Lines RegisteredIndividual betting lines registered with ProphetX.
Quotes SentParlay price quotes submitted in response to RFQs.
OfferedPX matched our quote and presented it to the bettor — but the bettor hasn't accepted the final terms yet (no orderUuid). May time out (~10 min) and become a phantom if accept never arrives.
AcceptedBettor confirmed the parlay; PX issued an orderUuid (via order.finalized). This is the source of truth for "on the book" — only Accepted parlays appear in Open Positions and contribute to risk/exposure.
SettledAccepted parlays that have fully settled (won/lost/push).
Running P&LCumulative profit/loss from all settled parlays.
Fair ProbDe-vigged probability of the parlay winning.
Offered OddsAmerican odds we quoted with vig margin applied.
VigOur profit margin on fair probability.
Max Exposure / TeamMax total risk across all active parlays per team.
Odds CacheLive odds from SharpAPI and The Odds API.

▼How this works

Purpose: bulk-post limit offers for both (or one) side of PX golf matchup markets from your single-leg PX account, using the same fair-prob and vig pipeline the parlay SP uses for RFQs.

Per-side asymmetry: each row is one side of one matchup. Set risk + enable independently per side.

Lifecycle (auto every GOLF_SINGLE_LEG_REFRESH_MINUTES): discover new PX matchups → upsert config (default enabled=false, risk=null) → cancel wagers for matchups that disappeared or are within GOLF_SINGLE_LEG_CANCEL_BEFORE_TEEOFF_MINUTES of tee → for each active wager, recompute fair and cancel+repost if drift ≥ GOLF_SINGLE_LEG_DRIFT_PPpp implied → post offers for any enabled+risk-set side that doesn't have an active wager.

Account isolation: uses PX_SINGLE_ACCESS_KEY/PX_SINGLE_SECRET_KEY via services/px-single.js; never touches the parlay SP's PX session.

Manual buttons: Sync = discover only. Post All = post enabled rows. Repost = drift-check + post. Cancel All = cancel every active wager (use carefully).

▼How this works

Purpose: bulk-post YES offers on PX golf outright markets (Top 1/5/10/20/Make Cut) from the single-leg PX account, priced from DraftKings with a small sweetener. DK is used (not DataGolf) because DK uses ties-included settlement that matches PX; DataGolf uses dead-heat rules that don't.

Pricing: offered_implied = dk_implied × (1 + GOLF_OUTRIGHTS_SWEETENER). Default sweetener 1%. Per-fill edge ≈ sweetener × stake.

Workflow: (1) paste a DK tournament URL into the Tournaments card and click Add. (2) Click Sync on that tournament — scrapes DK + matches players to PX outright lines. (3) Use bulk-apply to set Risk $ on all players, click Enable on the ones you want. Save Edits. (4) Post All.

Lifecycle (auto every GOLF_OUTRIGHTS_REFRESH_MINUTES): sync each enabled tournament from DK → for each active wager, recompute the DK implied and cancel+repost if drift ≥ GOLF_OUTRIGHTS_DRIFT_PPpp → post any newly-enabled players.

Account isolation: uses the same PX_SINGLE_ACCESS_KEY/PX_SINGLE_SECRET_KEY as Golf Single-Leg; never touches the parlay SP.
